elements.name: Event producers
elements.description: Tenant clients that send events to the gateway's HTTP ingest.

elements.name: Query consumers
elements.description: Clients that send structured HTTP/JSON queries.

elements.name: Operators
elements.description: Read /metrics, /hotkeys and pprof on the debug address; start and stop the processes.

elements.name: Workload simulation harness (internal/sim)
elements.description: Seeded PRNG streams, virtual clock, event loop, traffic generators (Zipf, Burst/RetryStorm, HighCardinality, Mix), differential oracle runner with ddmin.

elements.name: E2E suite (test/e2e)
elements.description: Builds and starts the real binaries (1 gateway + N shards), sends sim workloads over real sockets, compares against an in-test oracle.

elements.name: Analytics Edge Gateway platform
elements.description: Ingestion edge gateway plus sharded real-time OLAP engine, two processes, in-memory storage only.

elements.name: cmd/gateway
elements.description: Ingestion edge proxy and rate-limiting router entrypoint; also hosts /query as the query coordinator (PLAN §9 Q6, recommended).

elements.name: cmd/analytics (shard, ×N)
elements.description: Sharded OLAP query worker node entrypoint.

elements.name: internal/pipeline
elements.description: Sans-IO gateway core: parse → limit → hot-key → route → ring → forwarder.

elements.name: Query coordinator (/query)
elements.description: Fans a query out to shards and merges partial aggregates and HLL registers (merge code lives in internal/engine).

elements.name: internal/engine
elements.description: Sans-IO shard engine: column store, index, GROUP BY, HLL, query execution, coordinator merge.

elements.name: internal/wire
elements.description: Gateway→shard binary frame format and query messages. Linked into both processes; modelled once, under cmd/gateway.

elements.name: internal/xhash
elements.description: Deterministic, seedable 64-bit hashing (xxHash64 + integer mixer) shared by the primitives. One Go package linked into both processes; this element is the copy in cmd/gateway (the other is in cmd/analytics).

elements.name: internal/xhash
elements.description: Deterministic, seedable 64-bit hashing (xxHash64 + integer mixer) shared by the primitives. One Go package linked into both processes; this element is the copy in cmd/analytics (the other is in cmd/gateway).

elements.name: internal/pad
elements.description: Cache-line size constant per architecture.

elements.name: Line parse
elements.description: Zero-alloc parse of the compact ingest line format from pooled buffers.

elements.name: Per-tenant GCRA limit
elements.description: Per-tenant rate limiting via internal/ratelimit (GCRA by default).

elements.name: Hot-key check and isolation
elements.description: Count-Min hot-key check and isolation via internal/sketch.

elements.name: Bounded-load route
elements.description: Shard selection via internal/router; assign on route, release on shard acknowledgement.

elements.name: Per-shard ring
elements.description: Lock-free hand-off via internal/ringbuf, one ring per shard.

elements.name: Batching forwarder
elements.description: Sends length-prefixed binary batches to shards; the only place retry (re-dial with capped backoff) is allowed.

elements.name: Append-only in-memory columns
elements.description: Column store for ingested events.

elements.name: Inverted index over tags
elements.description: internal/index: term → Roaring posting bitmap.

elements.name: SwissTable GROUP BY
elements.description: internal/hashmap aggregation with COUNT/SUM/MIN/MAX.

elements.name: Per-shard HLL
elements.description: internal/hll sketch for APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT.

elements.name: Query execution
elements.description: Filter tree over tags, optional group-by, aggregates.

elements.name: Coordinator merge
elements.description: Merges partial aggregates and HLL registers (element-wise max) across shards. Code in internal/engine; runs in the gateway's query coordinator.

elements.name: internal/ringbuf
elements.description: Lock-free SPSC and MPMC ring buffers with cache-line padding.

elements.name: Producer and consumer goroutines (the caller's)
elements.description: The ring buffer is passive: producers and consumers are the caller's goroutines (drawn as two boxes on the diagram).

elements.name: SPSC[T]
elements.description: Lamport ring; each side caches the other side's cursor.

elements.name: MPMC[T]
elements.description: Vyukov-style bounded queue with per-slot sequence numbers; CAS on the cursor.

elements.name: Padded cursors
elements.description: atomic.Uint64 sequence counters separated by cache-line pads (internal/pad).

elements.name: Blocking helpers
elements.description: Bounded spin → runtime.Gosched → park on a notification channel.

elements.name: internal/ratelimit
elements.description: Token Bucket and GCRA limiters, per-tenant state table.

elements.name: Per-tenant limiter table
elements.description: Tenant → limiter state, with idle eviction.

elements.name: GCRA
elements.description: One int64 TAT per tenant, updated with a single CAS; integer arithmetic.

elements.name: TokenBucket
elements.description: (tokens, last) per tenant; integer arithmetic; decision-equivalent to GCRA.

elements.name: internal/router
elements.description: Consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes and bounded loads.

elements.name: Ring
elements.description: Lookup, Assign, Release; membership add/remove.

elements.name: Immutable snapshot
elements.description: Sorted vnode points + parallel shard-index slice, binary search; swapped via atomic.Pointer on membership change.

elements.name: Per-shard load counters
elements.description: Bounded-load cap ⌈(1+ε)·(total+1)/n⌉; walk clockwise to the first shard under the cap.

elements.name: internal/sketch
elements.description: Count-Min Sketch and top-K hot-key detector.

elements.name: CountMin
elements.description: w×d uint32 saturating counters, double hashing; merge; windowed decay.

elements.name: TopK
elements.description: Heavy-hitter tracker (size-K min-heap with a small index) with a threshold query.

elements.name: internal/index
elements.description: Roaring bitmap containers and the inverted index.

elements.name: Inverted
elements.description: Term → posting bitmap; boolean query evaluation (AND/OR/NOT).

elements.name: Bitmap
elements.description: High 16 bits select a container (sorted keys, binary search); Add/Remove/Contains/And/Or/AndNot.

elements.name: Array container
elements.description: Sorted []uint16, up to and including 4,096 elements.

elements.name: Bitset container
elements.description: [1024]uint64 (8 KiB), from 4,097 elements.

elements.name: internal/hashmap
elements.description: SwissTable-style open-addressed hash map.

elements.name: Map[K, V]
elements.description: Put/Get/Delete; triangular group probing; tombstones with in-place rehash; doubling resize.

elements.name: Explicit hasher
elements.description: Constructor argument with a per-table seed; H1 selects the group, 7-bit H2 is the control byte.

elements.name: Control bytes
elements.description: Flat array, 16-slot groups: empty 0x80, deleted 0xFE, full = H2.

elements.name: Slot array
elements.description: Flat contiguous key/value slots.

elements.name: SWAR group match
elements.description: H2 and empty matching over two uint64 words per group.

elements.name: GROUP BY aggregation harness
elements.description: Aggregation harness used by the benchmarks.

elements.name: internal/hll
elements.description: HyperLogLog (p=14) with register merge.

elements.name: Sketch
elements.description: 16,384 one-byte registers; Add; Merge (element-wise max); mismatched precision/seed refused with *hll.MismatchError.

elements.name: Estimate
elements.description: Small/large-range corrected estimator (Ertl improved recommended as primary, PLAN §9 Q11); classic estimator kept for comparison.

elements.name: Register encode/decode
elements.description: Binary encode/decode of registers.
